svg.title: Project Genome system architecture
svg.desc: Supported project files are parsed and analyzed locally. Manifest, static import, vulnerability and RAG evidence flow into contextual risk and the LangChain explanation agent. The analyst reviews a report and may run a non-mutating hypothetical-version lookup.
svg.text: PROJECT GENOME · Evidence-Bounded Architecture
Analyst Input
requirements*.txt · Python .py source · question · optional hypothetical version
Unsupported formats reported; Python source is parsed locally and never executed
Project Analyzer
Pinned dependency inventory · AST import mapping · unpinned/conflicting declarations · unknowns
Evidence graph: manifest declarations + static imports + returned advisory links
No inferred transitive edges, runtime reachability, deployment context, or exploitability
Evidence Tools
OSV exact-version lookup · dependency summary
Bounded calls · failure status · provenance
Local Security Guidance
Chunked curated corpus · sparse concept vectors
Guidance only; never project vulnerability evidence
Contextual Risk + LangChain Agent
Observed risk dimensions · unknowns · evidence coverage · bounded tool-calling synthesis
Heuristic score, not validated ML; missing vulnerability evidence stays unknown
Project Genome Analyst Views
Overview · Map · Signals · Paths · Evidence · Human Review
What-if: exact hypothetical OSV lookup; no file changes
Session analyst context + answer-style feedback
